title: The Moran family of New Orleans bassists and guitarists
summary: Braud names William Moran and his sons John, Lawrence, Simon and Eddie, and they note who is alive.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Who's this fellow Moran that you mentioned? William Moran.
He's from New Orleans. He had a son by the name of John Moran. Moran, a Moran, a letter. Of course, we always say Moran. Oh, oh. Billy Moran. Billy Moran, yeah. That's him.
And Lawrence is still a player.
And he had a fellow, his son by the name of John Moran. He was a very fine guitar player. Lawrence played fine guitar, too. And his son, Simon Moran. Very fine bass player. I don't know if y'all are.
He's still here. I heard him play one.
I thought he was dead. I know John is dead.
John was dead. John died in New York.
Simon was still here last time here. Eddie is. Did Eddie die? There's another man. I didn't know Eddie.
